title: Liking Bias
coreMove: Detect when the liking bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Liking Bias as a specific decision error around liking bias, charm, similarity. Traceable support includes We rarely find that people have good sense unless they agree with us..
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Liking Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the liking bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
